catalogue.name: MA - Makhar
catalogue.readme:
Beyond the fringes of “civilisation”, the Makhar Steppe serves as home to many so-called barbarians. Raised in the saddle, they understand speed in a way few others can. They appear sweeping across the plains, swift and unstoppable as the howling winds.

Harnessing sleek and powerful horses, hulking karkadan and even great mammoths, it seems there are few creatures the Makhar would not ride into battle. No doubt these talents make them powerful allies and testing grounds for potential Warriors. Standing between the Wasteland and the rich realms of Vetia, the Makhar are frequently on the frontlines of war.

sharedRules.name: Recurve Bow
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 24″, Strength 3, AP 0, no Aim modifier for Moving and Shooting, may March & Shoot. When shooting at Short Range, it gains +1 to Hit and +1 Armour Penetration.

sharedRules.name: Battle Fever
sharedRules.description: The unit must reroll any result of ’1’ when rolling for Charge Range.

sharedRules.name: Light Ride
sharedRules.description: Models with this rule gain Light Troops.

sharedRules.name: Insignificant
sharedRules.description: The unit only causes Panic Tests on friendly units with Insignificant. A unit joined by a Character is no longer Insignificant.
